name: phone-showcase
title: Phone Showcase
description: One phone on a pastel field in a single take: the camera dives into the screen, a product card lifts out and is tapped into the cart, order notifications drop in and a count-up lands on a dark card.
useWhen: A small shop, app or creator should show how easy ordering from a phone is, in the brand colours.
The scene needs proof: a product picked, orders arriving, a number that climbs.
avoidWhen: You need a screen recording or the user's own screenshots in a device frame: this phone draws its own flat UI.
The message is a plain feature list: use a text block instead of a phone.
author: Mosio

variables.label: Headline
variables.description: Two lines separated by a vertical bar; the second line is set in the main colour.

variables.label: Shop name
variables.description: Name shown at the top of the phone screen.

variables.label: Greeting
variables.description: Small line above the shop name on the screen.

variables.label: Search hint
variables.description: Placeholder text in the screen search bar.

variables.label: Products
variables.description: Semicolon-separated entries "Name|Description|Price" (3 to 6). The third one is picked, lifts out of the screen and goes into the cart.

variables.label: Tag

variables.label: Button label

variables.label: Count label

variables.label: Growth badge

variables.label: Field

variables.label: Cards

variables.label: Main colour

variables.label: Accent

variables.label: Text
variables.description: Headline and screen text; also the dark count card.
